results.title: Changing Rooms
results.overview: César is 12 when his older sister Lou is the victim of sexual assault. In the changing rooms of his fencing club, the only standard that matters is violence. César wishes he could measure up but may not be armed for the fights to come.

results.title: Kayıkçı
results.overview: In 2085, a grieving mother hires a young ritualist (Kayikci) to bring her son back to life inside an isolated villa where reality fractures, and a forbidden resurrection unleashes a terrifying night : A night of ritual-driven surge of unease and escalating suspense.

results.title: B.O.F DEBUT SHOWCASE
results.overview: The debut showcase of B.O.F, the boyband originated from the TV show "Anh Trai Vượt Ngàn Chông Gai - Call Me By Fire 2024"

results.title: The Cure
results.overview: When August finds shelter in an abandoned ranch home, he goes down memory lane of his trauma and what his scientist mother, Dr. Edwards, did to him. Do you challenge your morals if you can find the cure for humanity?

results.title: Saturated Fats
results.overview: Before fleeing the country, former governor Julio Fechini transmitted existential knowledge called "Saturated Fats" to his dominatrix Greta Cohen. But what does "Saturated Fat" mean? Greta will reveal the secret to two couples of failed friends during an insane sadomasochistic retreat inspired by the barbecue ritual.

results.title: The Santa Class
results.overview: Kate North reluctantly takes over her father’s struggling Santa School, where she and a colleague discover an amnesiac Santa Claus and must help him regain his memories through their training program to save both the school and Christmas.

results.title: National Lampoon Presents: Jeeter PotLuck
results.overview: This short follows former NFL stars Ricky Williams and Calvin Johnson (aka Megatron) as neighbors invited to a big game watch party potluck. They show up with plenty of “greens” (cannabis, of course), but hilariously forget the actual salad or food.

results.title: Stardom 5STAR Grand Prix 2025 - Day 1
results.overview: The first night of the tournament took place at Ota City General Gymnasium in Tokyo, Japan on July 27, 2025.

results.title: The Fire and the Moth
results.overview: Violence and mayhem ensue after a smuggler escapes with a rare Ife bronze head into a gritty western Nigerian town.

results.title: The Holly King
results.overview: Four men gather to curse one of their ex-boyfriends by invoking the Holly King, an ancient elemental being, and end up biting off a little more than they can chew.

results.title: The Story of Super Mario
results.overview: Whether collecting coins, eating mushrooms or stomping on Goombas, Mario is an icon who has graced our screens for generations. Everyone remembers their very first time jumping around in one of his iconic games, but you may not know the full history of Nintendo's greatest hit. Join us as we do just that, and reach for the goal as we learn The Story of Super Mario.

results.title: The Footballest 2
results.original_title: Los futbolísimos  2 y el misterio del tesoro pirata
results.overview: The Soto Alto football team, formed by Pakete and his friends, is at risk of being kicked out of the league. Thanks to a scam by a property development company, they’ve lost their pitch and now Los Justos, the team from a local reform school, looks set to take their place.

results.title: Gift from a Cloud
results.overview: After being officially declared dead, Qin Tian miraculously returns—eight years younger and with his memory erased—giving his wife Xiao Fan an unexpected second chance to rediscover love with the man she once lost.

results.title: The Upstanding Millars (of Society)
results.overview: The Millars - Malta's most prominent artists and philanthropists - are winding down after celebrating their gold wedding anniversary, when they're interrupted by a knock in the middle of the night. A man humbly asks for their help. The Millars oblige, because their charity is bottomless - but so is their need to make art.

results.title: Ho Aloha
results.overview: No one knows what's inside the treasure box, but it's said that opening it reveals the life you've dreamed of and eternal happiness.  This journey is about to begin. No one knows what will happen. Join us on an adventure to find this treasure box of memories at the event.

results.title: Blackout
results.overview: In a building owned by a conservative family, a tenant is accused of bringing bad luck when its patriarch falls ill. When the grandson who fancies her sees her with a man, he joins forces with the women to punish her.

results.title: Alright
results.overview: After the death of his wife, a recently estranged father is forced to reconcile with his daughter through the unlikeliest of means: the Nutcracker.
